intro: The plural genitive can end at zero, -ов / -ев or -ей, and there are irregular forms: книг, столов, музеев, друзей.

bloques.titulo: The plural genitive can end at zero, -ов / -ев or -ей, and there are irregular forms: книг, столов, музеев, друзей.
texto: The plural genitive can end at zero, -ов / -ев or -ей, and there are irregular forms: книг, столов, музеев, друзей.
There is no single termination; learn each group with frequent words and check irregular forms.

frases.es: En la ciudad hay muchos museos.
frases.en: There are many museums in the city.
We don't have any new books.

bloques.pregunta: What is the plural genius of музей?

opciones.explicacion: Музей forms the plural genitive in -ев.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.
